title: Remove a validator
body: Gov.Remove-Validator. Refused while it has a commit in flight. Its full bond is refunded: governance never takes a bond. It moves money or code, so it carries Effective-At (filled by dao-propose: the vote's end + 24 h + 1 day of margin); it takes effect only then, when anyone sends Gov.Apply, and until then validators may leave by the exit hatch (Exit-Now) and the DAO may cancel it (Gov.Cancel).
